adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Expressive, improvised gestures swinging outward from the hips
movement_profile.difficulty: beginner to intermediate depending on improvisation skill
movement_profile.footwork: Flat-footed shuffling and gentle stomping in polyrhythmic timing
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Performed solo or in small groups, stationary or small circular patterns
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Movements radiate outward from the hips with angular isolations
movement_profile.posture: Downward, earth-bound with flexed knees and slight forward bend

signature_moves.description: Flat-footed shuffling step with flexed knees, grounding the dancer to the earth.
signature_moves.name: Spirit Shuffle

signature_moves.description: Angular swinging of hips outward, expressing connection to the spirit world.
signature_moves.name: Hip Swing

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Flexible tempo aligned with spiritual mood, generally moderate to slow
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid performing the dance outside its sacred context or by those not initiated; avoid fast, high-impact movements that disrupt the ritual flow.

music_profile.musical_form: cyclical patterns facilitating trance and spirit communication
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: complex interlocking mbira melodies supported by steady drum and hosho shaker rhythms
music_profile.sound_description: The mbira produces bright, melodic plucked tones layered over steady drum beats and rattling hosho shakers, creating a textured, polyrhythmic soundscape that supports trance and spirit invocation.
music_profile.tempo_bpm: variable, generally moderate to slow to accommodate spirit possession
music_profile.vocal_style: communal singing and call-and-response during rituals

basic_steps: Stand with knees flexed and feet flat on the ground
Shuffle feet gently in rhythm with the mbira music
Maintain a downward, earth-bound posture with slight forward bend at the waist
Use arms and hands to express improvisational gestures outward from the hips
Follow the polyrhythmic tempo, adjusting movements to the spirit of the music
teaching.formation: Solo or small group, elders leading; natural outdoor setting preferred
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with basic foot shuffling and posture; advanced dancers improvise rhythmic variations and expressive gestures
teaching.rhythm: Polyrhythmic, interlocking patterns with flexible tempo influenced by spiritual context
